description: This file defines the ServerRequest class implementing PSR-7 ServerRequestInterface; it handles HTTP server-side request data, including server parameters, uploaded files, cookies, query parameters, and attributes. It provides methods to access and modify these properties immutably.

classes.name: ServerRequest
classes.description: Implementation of a server-side HTTP request following PSR-7, providing access to server info, uploaded files, cookies, query parameters, attributes, and request body, with immutability.

methods.name: withUploadedFiles
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified uploaded files.

methods.name: withCookieParams
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified cookies.

methods.name: withQueryParams
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified query parameters.

methods.name: withParsedBody
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified parsed body.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Returns a specific request attribute or default.

methods.name: withAttribute
methods.description: Returns a new instance with a specified attribute set.

methods.name: withoutAttribute
methods.description: Returns a new instance without a specified attribute.

methods.name: validateUploadedFiles
methods.description: Validates the structure of uploaded files, ensuring each leaf is an UploadedFileInterface.
